Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min Redwood demo for FinPay

Hi Alicia (and Tom),

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and helpful context on your payments fraud use case. As discussed, the next step is a 30-minute product demo to walk through Redwood's inference runtime, routing/fallbacks, and a quick look at observability (latency/cost dashboards).

Proposed 30-min options (PT):
- Option A: Wed, Mar 24 — 10:00—10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Thu, Mar 25 — 11:30 AM—12:00 PM PT
- Option C: Fri, Mar 26 — 2:00—2:30 PM PT

Please let me know which option works best and who from your side should join (engineering, product, SRE). If none of these work, share two times that do and we'll accommodate. I've attached a short agenda and will send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Agenda stub: 1) 10m product overview + architecture; 2) 10m demo of runtime and observability; 3) 10m Q&A & next steps.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0123

Quick answers:
- We should include Tom (Head of Engineering) and I'll also loop in Priya (SRE) — I'll forward the invite to her once we have a time.
- FinPay is on ET; the times listed look fine but please note the timezone shift (10:00 AM PT = 1:00 PM ET).

Our preference is Option B (Thu, Mar 25 — 11:30 AM PT / 2:30 PM ET). If you can send the invite for that slot, I'll confirm with Priya and Tom.

On a related note, we may want a short technical deep dive with SRE after the intro demo; happy to coordinate that follow-up separately.
